propositions: A single monolithic test iterating over 884 corpus units with ~1768 serial pandoc spawns exceeds the CI per-test timeout of 300s under CPU contention on macOS (measured 504.8s saturated vs 91.6s idle), causing pytest-timeout's thread method to kill the xdist worker with os._exit(1) rather than a test failure.

The test failure manifests as worker crash with no traceback reported when running on macOS py3.13 in the Verified cell, while the identical code passes on ubuntu cells, indicating the fault is load and machine dependent, not a logic error.

Replacing the monolithic loop with chunk-parametrized test cases (chunk size 40) bounded by construction reduces per-test cost from 504.8s saturated to 38.05s (7.9x headroom under 300s guard) while comparing all 884 units against the oracle with real pandoc.

A coverage guard test (test_the_equivalence_chunks_cover_every_renderable_unit) ensures the concatenation of all chunks equals the full unit list and meets the >= 100 minimum threshold, preventing silent unit drops from chunking.
